narrative.overview:
A Nordic daily's front page reduced to its fact boxes. Every house is a headline plus a ruled strip of facts; the page is hairline rules and one grotesk, and it refuses the photo-card grid with coloured badges every listing site ships. Density is low, so each entry gets room, but nothing inside a module is decorated.

Two grounds only: white paper in light, near-black in dark. One signal colour, cobalt, for what is new and for hover. Everything else is ink at two strengths. State is typographic (weight, rule, strike, colour on a word), never a pill, icon or shadow.
keyCharacteristics: Hairline rules do all the structure; no boxes, no cards.
One face, Schibsted Grotesk, in seven size steps; rank by weight before size.
Cobalt is a word, not a surface.
Grey (ink-2) means lower rank, never disabled.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Cobalt appears on words and rings only. A second hue is a defect.

rules.name: The Weight Before Size Rule
rules.body: Inside a line, rank is weight (price 700, rest 400); size steps separate headline, facts and meta.

rules.name: The Two Rules Rule
rules.body: Full-ink rule for section boundaries, hairline for everything inside.

dos: Do express every state with weight, a rule, a strike, or the signal on a word.
Do keep the two line strengths and radius 0.
Do keep ink-2 text at or above 4.5:1 in both themes.
donts: Don't add cards, boxes or shadows.
Don't add pills, badges, chips or filled buttons.
Don't add icons; controls are words.
Don't introduce a second colour or a cream ground.
